answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 30821 Country: India Title: I would like to ask you that meat from hunting animal with shotgun(shikar)is halal or haram.if animal get died due to shotgun before zibah then this will b haram or halal. Question: I would like to ask you that meat from hunting animal with shotgun(shikar)is halal or haram.if animal get died due to shotgun before zibah then this will b haram or halal. Answer ID: 30821 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 476/476/M=1432) If the prey dies after being shot and one does not find time to slaughter it, then the meat is not halal. But, it is halal if it is slaughtered as per the Shariah before it dies. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
